story_review.one_viewing_summary: Code-scope chain. Scrub-sleeved arms type at the desk, and a final key strike sends the question card across the wall chart into the wall-mounted OpenEvidence AI tool. One answer drops out below the tool's mouth line, and three citation cards tuck into its Sources slot. Dated tags pin to the record boundary. A sign-in opens the record lock. A tight detail shows the right hand typing as the question fills. The citations fan out and literature and guidelines lift. More than half of the clinician tokens light, labelled as UTMB's own report. Tags reading 'Not in release' clip onto the answer, the Accuracy slot pulses empty, and the use-and-experience tag pins to the share.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The opening asks what comes back when a UTMB clinician asks inside the record. The closing hold answers with the same answer card beside the chart: its Sources slot glows full, its Accuracy ring pulses empty, and its limit tags are clear of the keyboard. The use-and-experience tag stays on the share. Everything stays within c1 to c8.
